description: Registers an HTTPS endpoint that receives the listed events. Event names and payload schemas are in the webhooks section of this API reference (and in the MCP resource blindpay://webhooks/events). Deliveries are signed with Svix; read the signing secret with Retrieve Webhook Secret and verify every delivery.

Idempotency-Key.description: Optional key to safely retry this request without performing the action twice. Retrying with the same key and an identical body replays the original response; reusing a key with a different body returns an error. Keys are kept for 24 hours.

name: PostV1InstancesWebhookEndpoints
title: Post Instances Webhook Endpoints
